versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI大模型专家｜Claude API中转。

- Offers unified API relay for Claude/Anthropic models, supporting key management, quota, routing, auditing, and async tasks.
- Provides secure token isolation, configurable cost/speed/success routing, and rollback for failures.
- Includes scripts for onboarding, task testing, and performance snapshots for image/video models.
- Designed for AI tool platforms, relay operators, enterprise R&D, content studios, and e-commerce tech teams.
- Supports smooth migration for existing API relay/Token Hub/AI gateways into monitored, auditable workflows.
- Product is part of Beijing Jirui Technology’s AI-HIVE, tailored for use cases in short drama, comics, video, and content production.
